##### Project general facts

Moonstone Interiors by Missoni emerges as an extraordinary residential masterpiece on Al Marjan Island, offering a refined collection of 225 residences ranging from one to four-bedroom apartments and luxury villas, all inspired by the organic beauty of coral formations. This exceptional development derives its name and architectural identity from the Moonstone coral, with a distinctive M-shaped design that maximizes breathtaking sea views from every residence. A single loaded corridor design ensures unobstructed panoramic vistas of the Arabian Gulf from every apartment, while spacious balconies with movable sunscreens and full vision glass panels create seamless indoor-outdoor living.

The amenities at Moonstone Interiors by Missoni are designed to elevate every aspect of wellbeing and relaxation, featuring a magnificent swimming pool, a state-of-the-art gym, and a serene spa complete with steam room and sauna. The development also offers dedicated playgrounds for younger residents, ensuring that every member of the family finds their perfect space for recreation and rejuvenation. Every amenity has been thoughtfully curated to complement the coastal lifestyle, creating a sanctuary where luxury and tranquility exist in perfect harmony.

The interiors of Moonstone Interiors by Missoni are a celebration of modern elegance, featuring contemporary finishes with high-quality materials throughout that reflect the refined aesthetic of the renowned Missoni brand. Each residence is presented in a semi-furnished state with furniture included, while the kitchens are fully equipped with premium appliances, ensuring effortless move-in readiness. The spacious balconies, generous layouts, and exquisite detailing create living spaces that are both sophisticated and inviting, offering a truly elevated coastal lifestyle.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island is a stunning man-made archipelago located along the Arabian Gulf coastline, renowned for its picturesque white sandy beaches, luxurious resorts, and upscale residential developments. This prominent tourist destination is shaped like a coral reef and comprises four primary coral-shaped islands connected by a central boulevard, offering breathtaking sea views from every vantage point. The island's pristine beaches stretch along the coastline, providing an idyllic setting for sunbathing, swimming, and an array of exhilarating water sports.

The neighbourhood is home to a collection of world-class hotels and resorts, offering exceptional amenities and services that cater to both leisure and business travellers with unparalleled sophistication. Visitors and residents alike can indulge in private beaches, swimming pools, luxurious spas, and gourmet dining options that showcase the finest culinary experiences. The crystal-clear waters of the Arabian Gulf provide an ideal setting for water enthusiasts, with activities including jet skiing and paddleboarding available just moments from home.

The surroundings offer a wealth of attractions and experiences that cater to every lifestyle, from the tranquility of pristine beaches to the vibrant energy of upscale resorts and entertainment venues. The island's strategic location and growing international appeal make it an increasingly desirable destination for those seeking a refined coastal lifestyle. This distinguished address truly offers the best of both worlds, combining the serenity of island living with the dynamic allure of one of the region's most captivating destinations.
